purpose: Results of 100 distinct targeted search passes across the remaining hard gaps. Search repetition was varied by mechanism, data modality, access route and production context; rediscovered sources were excluded rather than re-counted.

searchAudit.interpretation: Only four sufficiently distinct and useful families survived duplicate and evidence-quality review. This low novelty rate is evidence of discovery saturation, not a reason to weaken admission standards.

sources.name: Six-month industrial polymer-melt stability / pre-defect drift corpus
sources.qualitySemantics: Operator-identified non-conforming parts are used to define pre-defect volatile windows; these derived windows must remain distinguished from directly observed defect labels.
sources.value: One of the strongest longitudinal real-production candidates found for gradual drift, pre-defect instability and maintenance-stop-aware temporal validation.
sources.dataAvailability: Article states original contributions are included in the article and further inquiries may be directed to the corresponding author; the underlying company cycle table is not established as openly reusable raw data.
sources.nextAction: Request an anonymized chronological cycle table preserving stop/maintenance boundaries, direct defect events, machine-state signals and rights for internal validation/derived aggregate publication.

sources.name: 150,000-shot SLM injection-mould tool-life production study
sources.tooling: four Stainless Steel 316L SLM-fabricated injection-mould tool insert sets
measuredEvidence: functional fit to automotive headlamp housing
sources.value: Net-new long-horizon tooling durability evidence with explicit shot counts and repeated dimensional/functional inspection. It strengthens natural tool-life evidence but is not a maintenance-intervention/recovery dataset.
sources.access: Open CC BY article with reported tables/figures; no separate machine-readable raw production table located in the 100-pass review.
sources.nextAction: Use publisher-verifiable tables as lower-level longitudinal tooling evidence and contact authors for batch-level dimensional measurements if reusable source data exist.

sources.name: Industrial mould wear-out survival dataset across multiple moulds
sources.reportedContext: Real datasets supplied by an industrial injection-moulding partner operating a multitude of moulds with differing geometry/size and running settings.
sources.value: Directly addresses multi-mould natural wear-out/lifetime prediction, a rarer evidence class than controlled wear tests.
sources.rights: Industrial partner data are described in the publication; no public reusable raw dataset or explicit redistribution permission was located.
sources.nextAction: Request controlled access or owner-side profiling with anonymized mould family, cycle/age exposure, event/censor status, maintenance history and failure definition retained.

sources.name: Operating-condition drift detection with incremental injection-moulding quality updates
sources.reportedOutcome: After incremental updating, the paper reports lower prediction error and a large reduction in anomaly rate across later production intervals.
sources.dataAvailability: Raw supporting data will be made available by the authors on request.
sources.value: Useful explicit chronological drift/update family for validating leakage-safe temporal monitoring and model-refresh logic.
sources.nextAction: Request the ordered per-mould dataset with original process signals, directly measured quality fields, sample/relabel boundaries and all update timestamps preserved.

saturationFinding: After 100 targeted passes, most high-ranking results were already represented by MM-DATA-001..174 or were lower-value article-only variants. Further generic web searching has sharply diminishing expected value compared with admission engineering and direct data-owner requests.
